description: Central permission catalog and role-to-permission mapping. Application code checks permissions, never role names.

permissions.description: Read customers of the caller's own branch.
Read only the customer row bound to the validated identity subject.
Read customers linked to credit applications assigned to the caller.
Read unmasked sensitive customer fields (IBAN, date of birth, contact data).
Book cash deposits and withdrawals on accounts of customers of the caller's own branch (always with explicit confirmation).
Plan transfers, cancel planned payments and pause/resume standing orders on the caller's OWN accounts (always with explicit confirmation).
Read credit applications assigned to the caller.
Add notes to credit applications the caller may read.
Approve submitted credit applications within the caller's approval limit.
Apply for a credit as a bank customer and read the applications one prepared oneself.
Read employee master data.
Read employee salary data and salary bands.
Read operational data such as failed jobs and incidents.
Read sanitized authorization audit records.
View the privileged, sanitized authorization trace.
Search and read documents permitted by the document ACL.
Ingest documents and update ingestion metadata.
Manage canonical document ACLs without content access.
Change platform configuration.
Use the AI assistant. Its tools act with the caller's own permissions; human principals only.
